titleText: Transport Malta workers get pay slashed for not punching in and out on overtime
mainText: From Times of Malta: Transport Malta workers get pay slashed for not punching in and out on overtime. Union threatens to stop fines and clamping unless the issue is resolved by Monday

titleText: Airport targeted by over 3.7 million hacking attempts in six months
mainText: From Times of Malta: Airport targeted by over 3.7 million hacking attempts in six months. Phishing emails the ‘biggest threat’, says head of airport IT department

titleText: Casa defeats far-right challenge to the ESF, EPP says
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Casa defeats far-right challenge to the ESF, EPP says. Members of the European Parliament today voted overwhelmingly in favour of the negotiating mandate secured by MEP David Casa for the post-2027 European Social Fund (ESF), decisively defeating a far-right objection to the text, the EPP said Wednesday.

titleText: PN calls for greater investment in prevention and support services to combat violence against women
mainText: From The Malta Independent: PN calls for greater investment in prevention and support services to combat violence against women. The Nationalist Party has called for greater investment in the prevention of gender-based violence, education grounded in respect and equality, and stronger support services for victims, while stressing the need to better address emerging forms of abuse, particularly digital violence.

titleText: Prison inmate Robert Agius caught with mobile phone just a month after similar incident
mainText: From MaltaToday: Prison inmate Robert Agius caught with mobile phone just a month after similar incident. Robert Agius, who is serving a life sentence, is the prison inmate caught with a mobile phone on Tuesday, MaltaToday has learnt. Known as Tal-Maksar, Agius had supplied the bomb that murdered Daphne Caruana Galizia.
